opus.why: Small, clearly specified README edits. The only lookup is reading docker-compose.yml to write a short Docker section.

fable.why: Three precise README edits plus a short Docker section read off docker-compose.yml; mechanical, scoped, 'don't touch the rest' is easy to honor.

opus.why: Turning a short Russian call summary into notes, with decisions and owner/deadline tasks split out. The content is all there; it just needs sorting.

fable.why: Restructuring a short Russian meeting dump into decisions, tasks with owners/deadlines, and open items; no judgment beyond faithful extraction.

opus.why: Client-facing rebranding pitch outline in English. The persuasive story and brand-strategy framing are judgment work where weaker models visibly drop in quality.

fable.why: Client-facing persuasive deck outline in English for a brand pitch; needs argument structure and brand judgment, but an outline with 2-3 bullets per slide doesn't need opus.

opus.why: Follow-up correction after an earlier miss: label currency on every row and convert the mixed LCU/EUR amounts to a correct EUR total. Accuracy matters and the user is already frustrated.

fable.why: Correction of a prior miss: label currency on every row and compute EUR total via the header rate. Simple but must be exact; high effort for strict instruction following and careful arithmetic (can run a script).

opus.why: Structured internal how-to for new devs built from Slack notes. Needs sound judgment on gaps, TODOs and the 'when not to hotfix' section, but the work is moderate.

fable.why: Turning a Slack dump into a one-page onboarding how-to with judgment on what's 'obvious' vs TODO; team-facing doc where clarity matters, sonnet medium holds quality.

opus.why: One-page Russian QC checklist that needs real post-production know-how (loudness, subtitles, color, export settings). Moderate creative and technical work.

fable.why: Professional QC checklist for editors needs real domain knowledge (loudness, safe areas, codecs, subtitle timing); haiku risks generic items. Short deliverable, medium suffices.

opus.why: Shortening one slide title the audience will read while keeping its meaning. A trivial task, but it is final copy.

fable.why: Compress one slide title to 8 words preserving meaning; trivial copy edit.

opus.why: Multi-tab Sheets break-even model with a scenario switch, a rent-mode toggle, monthly cumulative cash flow and payback. Formula correctness across sheets needs strong reasoning.

fable.why: Multi-tab break-even model spec with concrete cell addresses and cross-tab formulas, a rent-mode toggle, three scenarios, payback/break-even month; formula consistency and financial correctness are error-prone for smaller models.

opus.why: Client-facing rewrite that must reliably strip internal budget, margin and blame notes and keep a polite tone. Leaking any of it would be costly, so careful but not deep work.

fable.why: Client-facing rewrite of internal notes: must reliably strip every internal/sensitive remark and keep a polite tone; judgment on sensitivity warrants sonnet, task is short so medium.
